sources.title: BPC-157 as an Investigational Peptide Therapeutic: Biopharmaceutical Challenges, Formulation Strategies, and Translational Development Barriers
July 23-24, 2026 Meeting of the Pharmacy Compounding Advisory Committee

changes.rationale: The public regulatory card exposes this date. The July 23-24 PCAC meeting has occurred, so retaining a June 30 check date alongside post-meeting copy would misstate freshness. The review was refreshed on August 26, 2026 against FDA meeting materials and the current evidence review.

changes.expected_old_value: 2023-04/2026: FDA Category 2 restricted (503A bulk substances). 2026-04-22: Removed from Category 2 (gray zone, not Category 1 approved). 2026-07-23/24: FDA PCAC scheduled to review for 503A compounding eligibility, alongside KPV, TB-500, and MOTS-C.
changes.new_value: 2023-04/2026: FDA Category 2 restricted (503A bulk substances). 2026-04-22: Removed from Category 2 after nomination withdrawals; this did not place BPC-157 on the 503A Bulks List. 2026-07-23: FDA PCAC voted to recommend BPC-157-related bulk drug substances for the 503A Bulks List. The advisory recommendation is non-binding and did not itself create a final 503A rule; as of 2026-08-26, no final FDA rule adding BPC-157 was located.
changes.rationale: The existing changelog is chronologically false because the July 23 PCAC review has occurred. The committee voted 8-6 with one abstention to recommend inclusion. The replacement records that recommendation while preserving the essential regulatory boundary: advisory-committee recommendations are non-binding, the vote was not FDA drug approval, and the August 26 review did not locate a final 503A rule adding BPC-157.
